title: 高松宮記念の後に・遠ざかる背中

text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki completes the Takamatsunomiya Kinen and her fans' expectations for her climb ever higher.
But her behavior seems off ever since that day. She seems constantly distracted and distant…
The amount of attention Fuji Kiseki is getting from the world is reaching the point of becoming a social phenomenon. Next up is the Yasuda Kinen, a mile-long race that's right up her alley.
